Corollary
[finiteness of the fundamental group] 1. ch9:3.2Let $M$ be a complete Riemannian manifold with $\mathrm{Ric}_p(v)\ge \delta >0$, for all $p\in M$ and all $v\in T_p(M)$. Then the universal cover of $M$ is compact. In particular, the fundamental group $\pi _1(M)$ is finite.
